" />
    <meta name="twitter:image:alt" content="THE COLLECTIVES — HIRE. BUILD. CREATE. with the three-ring ecosystem mark." />
    <title>THE COLLECTIVES | HIRE. BUILD. CREATE.</title>
    <script type="application/ld+json">
      {
        "@context": "https://schema.org",
        "@type": "Organization",
        "name": "THE COLLECTIVES",
        "slogan": "HIRE. BUILD. CREATE.",
        "description": "One ecosystem connecting specialized talent, technology, and creative collectives.",
        "subOrganization": [
          { "@type": "Organization", "name": "Job Collective", "description": "Talent, staffing, and growth." },
          { "@type": "Organization", "name": "Code Collective", "description": "Development, automation, and innovation." },
          { "@type": "Organization", "name": "Creative Collective", "description": "Branding, content, and experience." }
        ]
      }
    </script>
    <style>
      .noscript-shell { min-height: 100vh; padding: clamp(32px, 8vw, 96px); display: grid; align-content: center; color: #f5f7fb; background: #07090e; font-family: inherit; }
      .noscript-shell img { width: min(180px, 46vw); height: auto; }
      .noscript-shell h1 { max-width: 900px; margin: 30px 0 18px; font-size: clamp(46px, 9vw, 96px); line-height: .92; letter-spacing: -.04em; }
      .noscript-shell > p { max-width: 700px; margin: 0; color: #b8c0cc; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.6; }
      .noscript-collectives { max-width: 760px; margin: 36px 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px 34px; }
      .noscript-collectives div { min-width: 180px; }
      .noscript-collectives dt { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; }
      .noscript-collectives div:nth-child(1) dt { color: #1e58ff; }
      .noscript-collectives div:nth-child(2) dt { color: #00c4a7; }
      .noscript-collectives div:nth-child(3) dt { color: #ffc107; }
      .noscript-collectives dd { margin: 6px 0 0; color: #f5f7fb; }
      .noscript-shell small { color: #9ba3ae; line-height: 1.5; }
    </style>
